scope: Ten pre-registered official documentation or repository URLs; no source discovery was performed.

verified_claims: The registered URL serves NVIDIA RAG Blueprint documentation.
records.boundary: This batch verifies the documentation entry is current and reachable; blueprint-specific component behavior must be tied to its own versioned documentation before publication.

verified_claims: Azure AI Search documents separate agentic retrieval with LLM-assisted query planning and multi-source access from classic RAG using hybrid search and semantic ranking.
Its agentic-retrieval guidance describes knowledge sources that generate chunking and vectorization pipelines.
records.boundary: The document describes Azure AI Search product patterns, not a vendor-neutral guarantee that either pattern is best for every system.

verified_claims: Azure Blob indexers use built-in timestamps to detect new and changed content.
The documentation states that object deletions are not tracked automatically and recommends a soft-delete strategy to avoid orphaned search documents.
records.boundary: This is Azure Blob indexer behavior; other ingestion systems require their own deletion-propagation design.

verified_claims: Azure documents document-level security filtering using identity or group metadata.
The POSIX-like ACL and RBAC-scope approach is documented as preview, so availability and API behavior are release-sensitive.
records.boundary: Security filtering is not a substitute for a complete authorization design, and preview features must not be presented as generally available.

verified_claims: Unstructured documents rule-based and model-based partitioning trade-offs in speed, cost and transformation quality.
The current guide describes VLM, High Res and Auto strategies; Auto is recommended there for runtime quality and cost optimization.
records.boundary: The recommendation is product-specific and must be tested against the document mix, quality target and budget of the target system.

verified_claims: The current documentation exposes basic, title, page and similarity chunking strategies.
It separately documents table handling, overlap settings and contextual chunking.
records.boundary: Available strategies and parameters are interfaces, not evidence that a particular strategy improves retrieval for every corpus.

verified_claims: The PII-redaction documentation exposes workflow placement, detection metadata and a configurable confidence threshold.
It distinguishes redaction mode from anonymization settings.
records.boundary: PII detection confidence is not a compliance guarantee; false positives, false negatives and audit requirements remain system-specific.

verified_claims: LangChain documents several document-splitting strategies and presents RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter as a common starting point for balancing context preservation and chunk-size management.
records.boundary: The stated default is framework guidance, not a universal RAG configuration recommendation.

verified_claims: The registered repository describes LiteParse as an open-source PDF parser with spatial text parsing and bounding boxes.
Its README lists Markdown, JSON and text outputs, table-oriented structured Markdown, OCR options and multiple language bindings.
records.boundary: Repository capabilities and performance must be treated as version-specific; this record does not certify production suitability.

verified_claims: Cohere documents search_document for passages to be searched and search_query for query embedding examples.
The current example uses output_dimension and embedding_types parameters with Embed v4.0.
records.boundary: Input types, model availability and vector-output options are API-version-specific and must be checked again when implementation begins.
